cells.name: circle
cells.species: length(p) - r: the one exact field every other shape starts from

cells.name: box
cells.species: axis box: outside corners round off, inside stays square

cells.name: round_box
cells.species: a box with four independent corner radii

cells.name: oriented_box
cells.species: a box between two end points with a thickness

cells.name: segment
cells.species: distance to a line segment, thickened by k0

cells.name: rhombus
cells.species: exact rhombus from one projection onto the side

cells.name: trapezoid
cells.species: isosceles trapezoid with two half widths and a half height

cells.name: parallelogram
cells.species: a skewed box; the skew rocks with the clock

cells.name: equilateral_tri
cells.species: equilateral triangle by folding into one sixth

cells.name: isosceles_tri
cells.species: isosceles triangle, apex on top

cells.name: uneven_capsule
cells.species: two circles of different radii joined by tangents

cells.name: pentagon
cells.species: regular pentagon by two reflections

cells.name: hexagon
cells.species: regular hexagon by one reflection

cells.name: octagon
cells.species: regular octagon by two reflections

cells.name: hexagram
cells.species: six point star of two triangles

cells.name: star
cells.species: n-point star; k0 sets the points, k1 the sharpness

cells.name: pie
cells.species: a circular sector with an opening angle

cells.name: arc
cells.species: a thick arc with round caps

cells.name: ring
cells.species: a cut ring with square ends

cells.name: horseshoe
cells.species: a ring with straight legs

cells.name: vesica
cells.species: the lens where two equal circles overlap

cells.name: moon
cells.species: a crescent: one circle minus another

cells.name: egg
cells.species: egg of three circle arcs, exact

cells.name: heart
cells.species: heart of two arcs and two lines, exact

cells.name: cross
cells.species: a plus sign with an optional outer rounding

cells.name: rounded_x
cells.species: two crossed capsules, exact

cells.name: polygon
cells.species: any closed polygon: edge distance plus an even-odd sign

cells.name: ellipse
cells.species: exact ellipse by Newton steps on the angle

cells.name: parabola
cells.species: y = k x²; the cubic root gives the foot point

cells.name: bezier
cells.species: quadratic Bézier: closest point by a cubic, thickened

cells.name: blobby_cross
cells.species: a soft four-lobed cross from a parabola fold

cells.name: tunnel
cells.species: an arch: a box with a round top

cells.name: stairs
cells.species: a staircase of n steps, exact

cells.name: signed_field
cells.species: the raw signed value: tone brightness outside, cream inside, no bands

cells.name: iso_bands
cells.species: contour map: one flat band per distance step, shaded like terrain

cells.name: gradient_dirs
cells.species: the gradient on a grid: unit arrows point away from the edge

cells.name: grad_length
cells.species: |∇d| shows exact versus bound: left exact ellipse, right the cheap scaled circle

cells.name: lipschitz
cells.species: a warped field: hot hatching marks |∇d| > 1, where a tracer oversteps

cells.name: probe
cells.species: a probe point and its circle of radius |d|: it touches the nearest edge

cells.name: medial_axis
cells.species: the skeleton: where the gradient folds, the Laplacian spikes

cells.name: march_2d
cells.species: sphere tracing in 2D: each circle is a safe step, each ends on the edge

cells.name: op_union
cells.species: min(a, b): exact outside, a bound inside

cells.name: op_subtract
cells.species: max(a, -b): the circle cuts the box; only a bound

cells.name: op_intersect
cells.species: max(a, b): the overlap of both shapes

cells.name: smooth_poly
cells.species: quadratic smooth minimum: a fillet of width k

cells.name: smooth_exp
cells.species: exponential smooth minimum: never exact, never sharp

cells.name: smooth_circ
cells.species: circular smooth minimum: a true circular fillet

cells.name: op_xor
cells.species: exclusive or: union minus intersection

cells.name: op_round
cells.species: d - r: rounding grows the shape and rounds every corner

cells.name: op_onion
cells.species: abs(d) - r, three times: rings of rings

cells.name: repeat_inf
cells.species: p - s round(p/s): one shape, infinite copies, one evaluation

cells.name: repeat_limited
cells.species: repetition clamped to a 5 by 3 block

cells.name: repeat_mirror
cells.species: mirrored repetition: odd cells flip, so the seams match

cells.name: domain_warp
cells.species: warp the input point: the field bends but is no longer exact

cells.name: morph
cells.species: mix(a, b, s): a linear blend of two fields morphs the shapes

cells.name: bend
cells.species: rotate p by an angle that grows with x: a bent bar

cells.name: aa_fwidth
cells.species: left: hard step; right: smoothstep over fwidth(d), one pixel wide

cells.name: outline
cells.species: fill, gap and two strokes from one field: a sticker

cells.name: inner_glow
cells.species: exp(k d) inside the shape: light pooled along the edge

cells.name: outer_glow
cells.species: neon: a thin core and a 1 / (1 + (d/s)^2) halo

cells.name: drop_shadow
cells.species: the same field, offset and widened, is a soft shadow

cells.name: bevel
cells.species: emboss: a height ramp from d, a normal from its gradient, a turning light

cells.name: soft_shadow_2d
cells.species: march from each pixel to the light; min(k h / s) is the penumbra

cells.name: ao_2d
cells.species: ambient occlusion: how open the field is on a ring of probes

cells.name: metaballs
cells.species: seven balls merged by exponential smin, lit as a gooey bulge

cells.name: glyph_sdf
cells.species: a stroke font from segments and arcs; the weight is one subtraction

cells.name: glyph_effects
cells.species: one glyph field, four looks: shadow, outline, glow and fill

cells.name: msdf_corners
cells.species: left: one channel, bilinear from a coarse grid, rounds the corners. right: median of three keeps them

cells.name: ui_panels
cells.species: a card built from rounded boxes: shadow, header, avatar, text and a button

cells.name: icon_set
cells.species: nine icons, each a few primitives and booleans

cells.name: progress_rings
cells.species: three arcs with round caps on their tracks

cells.name: ui_controls
cells.species: a toggle, a slider, a checkbox and radio buttons, all fields
